content.comment_body: Hello, Has anyone experienced issues with [product_name] (version_no: [version_no]) and accessing its web interface? We have a [product_name] running [version_no] and have been using a webpage on it for over a year without problems. About a month or two ago, browser connectivity issues started – now, we can only open the login page with updated browsers by switching to IE compatibility mode. Without this, the web page doesn't load as expected. The issue does not seem related to certificates, and using outdated browsers or different OS versions still works. After enabling IE mode, another problem occurs: the custom web page only displays 'Loading!' even though it works correctly with old browsers. Has anyone with [version_no] tried accessing a custom web page on an updated browser like Edge? Does it work or is this a common problem? We need this resolved for our maintenance staff to use the web page effectively. Thank you.

A possible answer was found here: [url]. The current concern is whether [company_name] will release a fix for at least [version_no] devices, as this compatibility problem could have significant effects going forward. Thanks.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are reporting compatibility problems between web interfaces on [product_name] devices (specifically [version_no]) and modern browsers due to recent security updates. Custom web pages will not load unless using old browsers or enabling IE compatibility mode, which disrupts maintenance work and overall accessibility.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the web interface on [product_name] devices to function seamlessly with recent browsers, without requiring workarounds such as compatibility mode or outdated browsers.
